mentions.name: Health insurance calculator
mentions.description: This calculator recommends health insurance combinations that work for a visa application and for a long-term stay in Germany. A new iteration is in progress that will provide far better explanations.
mentions.problem: Choosing health insurance that works for a visa application and long-term stay in Germany is a huge financial decision for recent immigrants.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now I'm working on another iteration of my health insurance calculator (https://allaboutberlin.com/tools/health-insurance-calculator). It's kind of a big deal both because it's a huge financial decision for recent immigrants, and because it funds a big chunk of all the free stuff I'm putting out.
